g:HTMLPanel.span: Whether new feeds are learned, which model learns them, and what it is told

form:FormGroup.label: Learning
form:FormGroup.helpText: Whether a learning run may ask the AI at all. Off by default: AI translation is switched on document by document. Off, what has been learned goes on translating, and streams of feeds that nothing translates wait.

form:FormGroup.label: Model
form:FormGroup.helpText: The OpenAI-compatible model the learning runs ask. A feed's data is sent to it as it is, so choose one the data may go to.

form:FormGroup.label: Instructions to the AI
form:FormGroup.helpText: Added to every question this document asks, e.g. a naming convention, or which events a kind of record should become. For something about one feed alone, leave a note on it on the Feeds tab.

form:TextArea.placeholder: For example: prefer Network/Open and Network/Close for connection events.

g:HTMLPanel.span: The steps the AI takes to write a translation, and the limits on a learning run. Choose a step on the route map to change it.

form:FormGroup.label: Tries per step, unless a step says otherwise
form:FormGroup.helpText: How many answers a step asks for before it has run out of tries, where the step doesn't say. Each answer that falls short is asked again with what fell short.

form:FormGroup.label: Time for each run
form:FormGroup.helpText: The longest one run of learning may take, every question in it included. A run that runs out pauses for a person, who can give it more. A run carried on again has the whole of it again.

form:FormGroup.label: Tokens for a whole run
form:FormGroup.helpText: The most tokens one run of learning may spend over its life. Zero means no limit. A run that runs out pauses for a person, who can give it more.

form:FormGroup.label: Largest sample of a stream (bytes)
form:FormGroup.helpText: The most of a stream the AI is shown, cut at whole lines. Every answer is still run over the whole stream.

g:HTMLPanel.span: What every translation is scored against, both while it is learned and once it is in use

tx:Label.text: Every answer the AI gives is run over the feed's own data and judged by these checks, and so is every record translated afterwards. One record short of them and its stream waits while the feed is learned again.

form:FormGroup.label: Start from
form:FormGroup.helpText: A starting set of checks. Choosing one replaces the checks below; changing any check afterwards makes the set this document's own.

form:FormGroup.label: Lines kept back to test against (%)
form:FormGroup.helpText: The share of a text stream's lines the AI is not shown, so that each answer is judged on records it has not seen.

g:HTMLPanel.span: The score a new translation needs before it is used, who approves it, and what happens when one can't be finished

form:FormGroup.label: Pass mark (%)
form:FormGroup.helpText: The score overall a new translation must reach on the stream it was learned from before it is used. It must also do no worse than the last translation on any record translated before.

form:FormGroup.label: New translations
form:FormGroup.helpText: Used as soon as they pass: a translation that reaches the pass mark is put to use, and the streams that waited for it are tried again. Approved first: it waits on the Feeds tab, and its streams with it, until someone approves or rejects it.

form:FormGroup.label: Records before a translation is trusted
form:FormGroup.helpText: How many records a stream must bring before a translation learned from it is trusted. One learned from fewer is used on trial, and is accepted once enough clean records have passed through it.

form:FormGroup.label: If the transform can't be finished
form:FormGroup.helpText: What a feed gets when the step that writes the transform runs out of tries. Marked Unknown events keep the stream served, and a later learning run may turn them into a real translation; nothing turns a translation back into an Unknown. A parser that can't be written always stops learning.

g:HTMLPanel.span: When a translation in use is flagged, and when a stream waiting for one is overdue

form:FormGroup.label: Flag a translation in use below (%)
form:FormGroup.helpText: A translation whose score lately falls below this is flagged on the Feeds tab. It goes on translating; a record that falls short of the checks is what sends a feed back to be learned.

form:FormGroup.label: Records kept to check against later
form:FormGroup.helpText: The most records kept for each translation, that a later one must translate no worse.

form:FormGroup.label: Waiting streams overdue after
form:FormGroup.helpText: How long a stream may wait for its feed to be learned before the Feeds tab flags it as overdue. It goes on waiting; the flag is so that someone looks.
